CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.wr_plan_items (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  week_start DATE NOT NULL,
  item_number INT NOT NULL,
  item_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE (project_id, week_start, item_number)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_wr_plan_items_proj_week ON public.wr_plan_items (project_id, week_start);

=SELECT item_number, item_text, status FROM public.wr_plan_items WHERE project_id = '{{ $('WR: Hard Logic Engine').item.json.project_id }}' AND week_start = '{{ $now.startOf('week').toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd') }}'::date ORDER BY item_number;
